prepareReusablePDFsBeforeCompilationAfte: Prepare reusable PDFs before compilation. After you approve the references, LaTeX reuses them and spends less time processing images.
readTheSelectedProjectAndWriteProcessedI: Read the selected project and write processed images. File monitoring only refreshes status. Automatic processing never edits .tex references; changes need your approval.
systemNotificationsReportResultsAGlobalS: System notifications report results. A global shortcut starts quick processing. Both can be disabled in Settings.
